items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Paul Merez. Yeah, Paul Merez. ... [INTERVIEWEE] He came up there pretty early. I remember him. I remember him.

ctx.x: Oh, no, that boy, I know him. He just come from over in our jays. He come from across the river. We come up together on here. George Brunus and Milton Brunus, his brother. Yeah. And I forget this other boy. There was another boy come up here with an orchestra.
Paul Merez. Yeah, Paul Merez. Well, there was another trombonist down there, Tom Brown. Yeah, Tom Brown. Oh, he had a band.
He came up there pretty early. I remember him. I remember him.
